run_enumeration_infer: run brute-force enumeration inference on an RBM to find the optimal hidden and visible states
run_pomegranate_infer: run pomegranate-based inference on an RBM with configurable iterations and CUDA backend
run_pgmax_infer: run PGMax belief propagation inference on an RBM with JAX vmap batching
run_pgmpy_infer: run pgmpy MPLP MAP estimation inference on a Markov Network representing an RBM
calc_rbm_energies: calculate the energy of a restricted Boltzmann machine configuration given weights and biases
